source.origin: Resolved env/keychain provider key passed to secrets::masked

sink.baseline_code:
"jev: {} key {} — {}",
            source.describe(),
            secrets::masked(&key),
            match jev::health_check(&key, &endpoint) {
                jev::Health::Ok => "verified",
                jev::Health::Rejected => "rejected by API (401/403)",
                jev::Health::Unverified => "could not verify (network/API error)",
            }

alerts.authorized_output_contract: Status authorizes credential source/health, not fragments of the credential.
alerts.decision: Remove masked key value; report only source, configured state and closed health category.

remediation.validation_gate: Focused privacy/output fixture and exact-head CodeQL rescan; do not claim scanner closure before result.
remediation.remaining_risk: Other auth/model resource and privacy paths require C10.
